skills.description: The directing-performance chapter as a working take sheet: the five pre-lock gates, every performance beat logged with its direction, eyeline, dead-eyes check, framing, and route, and the performance-lock verdict from the chapter's rules.

skills.title: Run the longform sheet
skills.description: The long-form pipelines chapter as a working sheet: the five pre-lock gates, every scene logged with its stress test, storyboard, reference, dialogue route, draft tier, re-rolls, and route, and the feature-lock verdict from the chapter's rules.

skills.title: Walk the Path — the sequenced curriculum
skills.description: The guide's 241 skills sequenced into six stages in production order (data/v1/curriculum.json): walk them in order on path.html, check each skill off as it is actually done, and let each stage's milestone — not the calendar — say when to move on.

skills.title: Build the costed shot list
skills.description: Turn a scene plan into a per-shot list with model assignments, takes, and live costs.

skills.title: Plan a production with the Studio recipe
skills.description: Reproduce the Studio's deterministic planning logic from the raw API data: concept in, costed shot list + budget envelopes out.

skills.title: Track a model's price and status changes
skills.description: Follow one model across models.json, the model-watch freshness feed, and the review queue to answer 'what changed and when'.

skills.title: Lock a mini-drama series bible
skills.description: Set up the series record the episode planner persists: title, logline, hashtag, and the cast with voice IDs + one-line visual anchors.

skills.title: Pick the serialized format for a series
skills.description: Choose among the five proven serialized formats (mini-drama, POV series, day-in-the-life, revenge arc, interactive) or custom — each with its runtime band and beat skeleton.

skills.title: Plan an episode block with runtime estimate
skills.description: Build one episode block (one emotion, 3-5 beats, turn, cliffhanger) and verify it against the format's runtime band.

skills.title: Send planner blocks to the Studio
skills.description: One-click bridge: stage the episode planner's saved series (title, logline, cast anchors, every block's format/runtime/beats) into the Studio's series mode for a full costed packet — or into microdrama mode for the run economics.

skills.title: Plan comment-driven interactive episodes
skills.description: Run the interactive serialized format: one decision per episode, a poll/comment beat that freezes on the choice, and a cliffhanger at the next decision — with viewer comments shaping the following episode's block.

skills.title: Plan a mini-drama season with Studio 2.0
skills.description: Plan 3-10 episodes in one pass: pick one of the 4 serialized format presets, lock the series bible, get per-episode shot lists with prompts, model picks, budget, and schedule.

skills.title: Export the production packet for a collaborator
skills.description: Turn any Studio plan into a hand-offable artifact: markdown download, self-contained HTML (series), or print/PDF — with shots, prompts, model math, budget, schedule, bible, and checklist.

skills.title: Plan a microdrama run's economics (Studio 2.5)
skills.description: Plan a serialized AI-microdrama run's economics from the documented $150-microdrama figures: clip budget, the $50/min benchmark, the 3-5x retake budget, the character-regen reserve, and the documented-pace timeline.

skills.title: Run a file-driven production office
skills.description: Set up an agent crew as the film's production office: a SKILL.md pipeline file, a references/ folder (templates, safety memory, style lock, story notes), and a tracking/ folder — so the production survives context death.

skills.title: Split the production into separately controllable components
skills.description: Architect a generation pipeline as separate character-identity, world, and action components with progressive-change workflows — so any element can be revised without regenerating the others, and late ideas land as parameter changes instead of restarts.
